title: Dhir and the art of bouncing back
Before radar, Britain tried to hear enemy bombers coming using giant concrete ‘ears’
description: Britain’s Denge Sound Mirrors, three concrete structures on the Kent coast built between 1928 and 1930, were designed to catch the drone of approaching bombers and give defenders a few extra minutes of warning. Faster aircraft, background noise and the arrival of radar made the mirrors obsolete by 1939.

title: Bismack Biyombo’s $1.3M donation: How did his father inspire his Congo hospital project?
description: Bismack Biyombo, after losing his father to COVID-19, decided to donate his entire NBA salary to support healthcare. His commitment aims to build a hospital in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, naming it after his father. This decision reflects Biyombo's desire to improve medical access for families facing financial challenges. He has previously engaged in community projects through his foundation, furthering healthcare and educational initiatives.
